help.title: HOW TO PLAY
help.subtitle: A quick guide to Hand Sabers

controls.title: Controls
controls.body: Stand in front of the camera and cut blocks with the matching saber. Escape pauses the game.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.body: Cut near the center and on beat. Correct direction and longer combos increase your score.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Place the camera at chest height, light yourself from the front, and keep your full arms visible.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.body: If sides are reversed, enable camera flipping. If sound is delayed, adjust the audio offset.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Use the menu button to open settings. Adjust audio, graphics, and gameplay to fit your preferences and PC power.

maps.title: Map library
maps.body: Open the Maps page to browse built-in maps, import new ones, or export your own creations from the editor.

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.body: Stand about 1–1.5 m from the camera. Complete all four calibration steps to match the play area and hand sides.

movement.title: Saber movement
movement.body: Move your full forearms. Keep both hands in frame and guide each blade through the center of incoming blocks.

hit.title: Hit on beat
hit.body: Cut each block with the matching saber and follow its arrow. Better timing and center accuracy earn more points.

tracking.title: Camera & lighting
tracking.body: Place your camera at chest height. Ensure good lighting from the front. Avoid backlight or dark rooms.

desc.lowest: Emergency mode: extremely low render resolution, minimum effects and lowest camera/ML load.

desc.low: For weak hardware: minimal effects, low GPU load and stable FPS.
desc.medium: For mid-range hardware: clear image, light background shader and moderate effects.
desc.high: For mid-to-good hardware: higher sharpness, light reflections and fuller effects.
desc.ultra: For good hardware: floor reflections, high sharpness and all effects.
desc.maximum: Best graphics settings: highest render resolution and richest effects.
